63: So they got TEN events?\n...Which homie I'mma pick?\fI only got one homie. It's a SUNKERN.
64: There's five Pokéathlon courses!\rSpeed, Power, Stamina, Jump, and\nSkill.\rPick your homies carefully.\nDon't bring a SLOWPOKE to Speed.\fI did. We came in sixth. Of four.
65: Some homies good at Speed events.\nSome ain't. Build a team that cover\feach other.\fLike a group project, except\feverybody actually do their part.
66: Keep goin' and you'll see the Museum\nof Pokéathlete Records.\rOne day I'mma have a record in there!\nMost Naps Taken During An Event.
67: Your score turn into Athlete Points,\nand you trade 'em for prizes.\rEven if you finish dead last,\nyour score still count!\fParticipation trophy energy.
68: “Hurdle Dash”\rMad Hurdles waitin' on your homies!\nBe faster than everybody! Jump the\fHurdles and go for number one!\fDon't trip. It's on camera.
69: “Pennant Capture”\rPennants hidden on the beach.\nFight over 'em and bring back as many\fas you can! Snatch 'em! Legally!
70: “Circle Push”\rTime to show off your homie's Power!\nPush 'em out and stay in the Circle!\fLike the club on a Friday.
71: “Block Smash”\rA mountain of Blocks waitin' on\nyour homies! SMASH 'em all!\fAnger management, but it's a sport.
72: “Disc Catch”\rDiscs get thrown at you. Jump and\ncatch 'em in the air!\rDon't get boxed in. Catch as many\nas you can! Like a dog at the park.
73: “Lamp Jump”\rYou never know how high you gon'\nbounce! Use Jump and Skill to score!\fDon't hit the ceilin'. Again.
74: “Relay Run”\rKeep runnin' till you can't run no\nmore! Three homies, one W!\fPass the baton. Don't drop it.\fWe see you, MEOWTH.
75: “Ring Drop”\rHomies tackle! Push past your Stamina\nand stay in the Ring!\fBasically wrestlin'. WWE rules.
76: “Snow Throw”\rA field colder than your ex,\nMILLIONS of Snowballs waitin'!\rAim and throw!\nTime it right! No ice in 'em!
77: “Goal Roll”\rPut your whole heart into hittin' the\nball! Attack! Defend your Goal!\rAim for the other Goals!\nWho gon' get the W?
78: Work with your homies. Believe in 'em\nand help 'em believe in you!\fBelieve in their potential.\fLet the friendship lead your team!\rThe Pokéathlon always with you!\fThat's on the gym wall. Every gym.
79: Charge up with friendship!\nGive Aprijuice to your homies!\fThey sponsor me. I gotta say it.
